<!-- Add Font Awesome CDN for icons -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.2/css/all.min.css">

<style>
  :root {
    --brand-orange: #d94d43;
    --text-light: #ffffff;
    --text-dark: #222222;
    --bg-cream: #f6f4ee;
    --card-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, sans-serif; background: var(--bg-cream); }

  .portfolio-container { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: 100vh; }
  @media (min-width: 992px) { .portfolio-container { grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 3.8fr; } }

  .profile-sidebar {
    background-color: var(--brand-orange);
    color: var(--text-light);
    padding: 3rem 2rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .avatar-frame { width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }
  .avatar-frame img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
  .profile-sidebar h1 { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; color: var(--text-light); line-height: 1.2; }
  .profile-sidebar h4 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.9; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.4; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding-bottom: 1.5rem; width: 100%; }
  .profile-sidebar p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; opacity: 0.85; margin-bottom: 2rem; text-align: left; }
  .sidebar-socials { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; font-size: 1.5rem; }
  .sidebar-socials a { color: var(--text-light); opacity: 0.85; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s; }
  .sidebar-socials a:hover { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); }
  .sidebar-skills-title { font-size: 0.9rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 1rem; opacity: 0.8; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; }
  .sidebar-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; }
  .sidebar-badge { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: var(--text-light); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

  .content-showcase { background-color: var(--bg-cream); padding: 4rem 3rem; }
  @media (max-width: 768px) { .content-showcase { padding: 2rem 1.5rem; } }

  .sidebar-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; padding-bottom: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
  .sidebar-nav a { color: #555555; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 30px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: all 0.2s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .sidebar-nav a:hover { color: var(--brand-orange); background: #ffffff; border-color: var(--brand-orange); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .sidebar-nav a.active { color: #ffffff; background: var(--brand-orange); border-color: var(--brand-orange); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(217,77,67,0.25); }

  .notes-header { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  .notes-header h2 { font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-dark); }
  .notes-sub { color: #777; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; max-width: 560px; line-height: 1.6; }

  /* ---- Thread stack grid ---- */
  .thread-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 2.5rem 2rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 992px) { .thread-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
  @media (max-width: 768px) { .thread-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  /* The "stack" is a fan of index cards behind the top card — depth = more entries in the thread */
  .thread-stack {
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    padding-bottom: 1.4rem; /* room for the fanned layers to peek out */
  }
  .thread-stack:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-orange); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 16px; }

  .stack-layer {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  }
  .stack-layer.l2 { transform: rotate(-4deg) translateY(10px); opacity: 0.55; z-index: 1; }
  .stack-layer.l1 { transform: rotate(3deg) translateY(6px); opacity: 0.8; z-index: 2; }

  .stack-top {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 3;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 1.6rem 1.5rem 1.4rem;
    box-shadow: var(--card-shadow);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
    border-top: 4px solid var(--brand-orange);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
  }
  .thread-stack:hover .stack-top { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.09); }
  .thread-stack:hover .stack-layer.l1 { transform: rotate(4deg) translateY(9px); }
  .thread-stack:hover .stack-layer.l2 { transform: rotate(-5deg) translateY(14px); }

  .stack-top .emoji { font-size: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; display: block; }
  .stack-top h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--text-dark); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; line-height: 1.35; }
  .stack-top .latest-preview { color: #777; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

  .stack-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .stack-tags span { background: var(--bg-cream); color: #886; color: #8a7a6f; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 20px; }

  .stack-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: #999; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding-top: 0.75rem; }
  .stack-count { color: var(--brand-orange); font-weight: 700; }

  .notes-empty { color: #888; font-size: 14px; padding: 2rem 0; }

  hr { margin: 2rem 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
  
  .side-by-side {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.side-by-side .img-col {
  flex: 0 0 30%;
}
.side-by-side .text-col {
  flex: 1;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .side-by-side { flex-direction: column; }
  .side-by-side .img-col { flex: 0 0 100%; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
}
</style>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }

  function fmtDate(d) {
    const hasTime = /T\d{2}:\d{2}/.test(d);
    const dt = new Date(hasTime ? d : d + "T00:00:00");
    if (isNaN(dt)) return d;
    const dateStr = dt.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
    if (!hasTime) return dateStr;
    const timeStr = dt.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
    return `${dateStr} · ${timeStr}`;
  }

  // Strips markdown formatting out of preview text so raw ``` / ** / [] markers never leak onto cards
  function previewText(text) {
    const hasCode = /```/.test(text);
    const cleaned = String(text)
      .replace(/```(\w+)?\n[\s\S]*?```/g, "")
      .replace(/\[(.*?)\]\(.*?\)/g, "$1")
      .replace(/[*_`#>]/g, "")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .trim();
    return cleaned + (hasCode ? "  💻" : "");
  }

  fetch("data/threads.json")
    .then((r) => r.json())
    .then((data) => {
      const grid = document.getElementById("thread-grid");
      const threads = (data.threads || []).slice();

      // Sort by most recently updated thread first
      threads.sort((a, b) => {
        const aLast = a.entries[a.entries.length - 1].date;
        const bLast = b.entries[b.entries.length - 1].date;
        return new Date(bLast) - new Date(aLast);
      });

      if (threads.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="notes-empty">No threads yet — the first one is on its way.</p>';
        return;
      }

      grid.innerHTML = threads
        .map((t) => {
          const count = t.entries.length;
          const latest = t.entries[t.entries.length - 1];
          const tags = (t.tags || [])
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map((tag) => `<span>${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`)
            .join("");

          // Depth of the fan reflects how many entries the thread actually has
          const layer1 = count > 1 ? '<div class="stack-layer l1"></div>' : "";
          const layer2 = count > 2 ? '<div class="stack-layer l2"></div>' : "";

          return `
            <a class="thread-stack" href="thread.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(t.id)}" aria-label="Open thread: ${escapeHtml(t.title)}, ${count} part${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}">
              ${layer2}
              ${layer1}
              <div class="stack-top">
                <span class="emoji">${t.emoji || "🧵"}</span>
                <h3>${escapeHtml(t.title)}</h3>
                <p class="latest-preview">${escapeHtml(latest.heading)} — ${escapeHtml(previewText(latest.content))}</p>
                <div class="stack-tags">${tags}</div>
                <div class="stack-meta">
                  <span class="stack-count">🧵 ${count} part${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}</span>
                  <span>updated ${fmtDate(latest.date)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </a>`;
        })
        .join("");
    })
    .catch(() => {
      document.getElementById("thread-grid").innerHTML =
        '<p class="notes-empty">Couldn\'t load threads right now — check data/threads.json.</p>';
    });
})();
</script>
```
